officialProductPage.evidence: Atomic's official page lists SKU AASS03786+, sizes 159/166/173/181 cm, per-size turn radii and tip/waist/tail geometry, Active Camber 0/100/0, 87° side edge, intermediate-to-advanced positioning, Power Woodcore (ash and poplar), Dura Cap Sidewall, Revoshock C, All-Condition Piste Shape, TI Powered, structured topsheet, World Cup Base Finish, Tip Protector, Pro Trak, and MI 12 GW binding bundle. The datasheet labels weight per ski and reports 2880 g at 173 cm.
officialProductPage.seasonEvidence: Atomic Japan's official catalogue archive lists a 2026/27 catalogue, while Atomic's official product page confirms model AASS03786+ and matching sizes but does not label the season. Product-specific listings from Skihaus Hellenberg and Sport Conrad identify the same model/article as 2026/27; season is cross-checked by exact model/article mapping, not asserted from the official product page alone. The former 2025/26 seed remains retired to draft because its season-specific SKU is unverified.
